summary: The note announces the 1st Conference of the 6th Season of the Philippines Shakey's V-League, which starts April 19 at the Filoil Flying V Arena. It lists the participating teams, including defending champion San Sebastian, and notes which teams joined at the quarterfinals. It also explains that La Salle took a leave of absence and UP replaced them in the eight-team elimination round.
one_line: Announcement of the 1st Conference of the 6th Shakey's V-League season, starting April 19 with its team lineup and roster changes.
key_facts: The 1st Conference of the 6th Season of the Philippines Shakey's V-League will start on April 19.
The 1st Conference of the 6th Season of the Philippines Shakey's V-League will be held at the Filoil Flying V Arena.
San Sebastian is the defending champion and current NCAA champion and is among the teams in the conference.
FEU is the UAAP runner-up and is among the teams in the conference.
Lyceum is the NCRAA champion and is among the teams in the conference.
Two Visayan teams, CESAFI champion USJ-R and USLS, join the conference at the quarterfinals.
UAAP champion La Salle decided not to compete and took a leave of absence.
UP replaced the Lady Archers to complete the eight-team elimination round roster.
